name: Click Smoother
description: Evens out wave spam (9-10 CPS) and ship flying (6-7 CPS) by filling in late clicks.

wave-cps.name: Wave spam threshold (CPS)
wave-cps.description: Wave assist activates when your average CPS is at or above this.

ship-cps.name: Ship threshold (CPS)
ship-cps.description: Ship assist activates when your average CPS is at or above this.

tolerance.name: Lateness tolerance
tolerance.description: Fill a click when the next one is this many times later than your average gap. Lower = more aggressive.

max-fills.name: Max consecutive fills
max-fills.description: Stops filling if you stop clicking.
